content: When <DstLo>_Transmit() returns E_NOT_OK for a routing path using a FIFO, the PDU Router shall report PduR.PDUR_E_PDU_INSTANCES_- LOST to the DET module.
When <DstLo/DstLoTp>_Transmit() returns E_NOT_OK for a routing path using a FIFO, the PDU Router shall report PduR.PDUR_E_PDU_- INSTANCES_LOST to the DET module.
